_about: KNOWN RECURRING RULES for engine/sport_calendar.py (Architect 2026-11-08 23:52: 'the system needs to understand all the calendar for each sport and each upcoming event'). These are LABELLED DEFAULTS, not dates: they only name a window the fetched data already shows (e.g. a club pause in a FIFA month is labelled 'international break'), or say what usually happens when no source covers the period (confidence low, source 'default rule'). Fetched data always wins. No date in the calendar comes from this file.

baseball.note: MLB Opening Day is usually late March; winter leagues (Caribbean) play Nov-Jan

tennis.note: tour season ends with the ATP/WTA Finals and the Davis Cup / Billie Jean King Cup finals in November; the new season starts in the first week of January

darts.note: the PDC World Championship usually runs mid-December to early January

snooker.note: the World Championship is usually mid-April to early May

rugby.note: November internationals (Autumn Nations Series) pause the club leagues for some rounds

cricket.note: the Big Bash League usually runs mid-December to late January
